name: dometrain-mcp
description: Bundled Dometrain MCP server (Dometrain-hosted remote HTTP, Bearer auth) for the dometrain grounding skills: search lessons, pull curated lesson documents with on-screen code, and get timestamped deep links. Requires an active Dometrain Pro subscription. Credential entered once through Claude Code's native masked userConfig prompt and stored in secure credential storage. Skip this plugin when you configure your own user-scope dometrain server.

dometrain_api_key.title: API key
dometrain_api_key.description: Dometrain account API key from https://dometrain.com/dashboard/account/ (MCP API keys section). Optional at enable time, but the remote server rejects requests that carry no key. Stored by Claude Code in secure credential storage, never settings.json.
